business_summary: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VIII focuses on effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses in technology industry. The company was incorporated in 2025 and is based in Zephyr Cove, Nevada.
